name: starci-harness
description: The StarCi harness CLI: every piece of AI agent work gets a contract of machine checks, is verified on a clean checkout, and only then committed.
author: starci183

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.prepack: npm run build && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); for (const d of ['ops','policy','contexts','skills/starci','packages/README.md','packages/jest-preset/README.md','CONTRIBUTING.md','LICENSE']) fs.cpSync('../'+d, d, {recursive: true}); if (!fs.existsSync('cli/README.md')) fs.cpSync('README.md', 'cli/README.md'); fs.cpSync('../README.md', 'README.md')"
scripts.postpack: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.cpSync('cli/README.md', 'README.md'); for (const d of ['ops','policy','contexts','skills','packages','cli','CONTRIBUTING.md','LICENSE']) fs.rmSync(d, {recursive: true, force: true})"
